parsed.basis: Partly a habit and partly plain judgement: I told myself to hold my line as a rule of thumb, then gave a little room at the last moment only to avoid my suitcase catching him. I know of no law or official rule telling pedestrians which side to pass on in a narrow Singapore corridor; it was not based on any specific guidance or study.
